CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFSCRIPT

CFSCRIPT lets you write CFML logic as compact statements instead of tags. Everything inside uses the same variables, scopes and functions as the rest of the page; it is simply a terser way to write CFSET, CFIF and CFLOOP.

Category

Flow control

Syntax

<CFSCRIPT>
  statements
</CFSCRIPT>

Usage

Each statement ends with a semicolon. CFScript knows these statements:

Statement Example
assignment x = 5;
function call WriteOutput("Hi");
if / else if (x GT 1) y = 2; else y = 3;
while while (i LT 10) { i = i + 1; }
do / while do { i = i + 1; } while (i LT 10);
for for (i = 1; i LTE 10; i = i + 1) { ... }
for / in for (key in MyStruct) { ... }
switch switch (x) { case 1: ...; break; default: ...; }
break, continue leave a loop, or skip to its next pass

Comments are written // to the end of the line or /* like this */. Use WriteOutput to send text to the page; it works whether or not the block sits inside CFOUTPUT.

Expressions use the normal CFML operators (EQ, LT, AND, & for joining strings...). As a convenience KoldFusion also accepts ==, !=, <, >, &&, ||, ++ and += inside CFSCRIPT, but ColdFusion 4.5 does not, so stick to the CFML operators in code you want to share. CFScript in version 4.5 has no user-defined functions and no try/catch: wrap the block in CFTRY when you need error handling. Tags cannot be used inside a script block.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="Staff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Department, Salary FROM Employees
</CFQUERY>

<CFSCRIPT>
// total the payroll per department in a structure
Payroll = StructNew();
depts = "";
for (row = 1; row LTE Staff.RecordCount; row = row + 1) {
    dept = Staff.Department[row];
    if (NOT StructKeyExists(Payroll, dept)) {
        Payroll[dept] = 0;
        depts = ListAppend(depts, dept);
    }
    Payroll[dept] = Payroll[dept] + Staff.Salary[row];
}

/* and print it as a table */
WriteOutput("<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3><TR><TH>Department</TH><TH>Payroll</TH><TH>Size</TH></TR>");
depts = ListSort(depts, "textnocase");
for (i = 1; i LTE ListLen(depts); i = i + 1) {
    dept = ListGetAt(depts, i);
    switch (dept) {
        case "Engineering": size = "Large"; break;
        case "Administration": case "Training": size = "Small"; break;
        default: size = "Medium";
    }
    WriteOutput("<TR><TD>" & dept & "</TD><TD ALIGN=RIGHT>" & DollarFormat(Payroll[dept]) & "</TD><TD>" & size & "</TD></TR>");
}
WriteOutput("</TABLE>");
</CFSCRIPT>
